brief.goal: Give the board-preview route, the style cutter and their tests one record to render, so the tooling is exercised before the first real page board exists.
brief.scope: Four sections, one per rendering family the route branches on: a hero, a prose section with an image, a review slot and an FAQ.
brief.done: The route builds, the cutter writes twelve blocks, and the board shows three styles per section at three widths.

strategy.name: fixture
strategy.why: The tooling needs a subject before the first page board is written.
strategy.trade_off: It is one more record to keep valid as the schema moves.

titles: Style preview fixture for the page board
descriptions: A fixture board record that the hidden preview route renders three ways per section, so the board tooling has a subject before the first page board.
The demo board record. It is not a page: it exists so the preview route, the style cutter and the board builder can be exercised end to end in tests.
Four sections, three styles each, rendered from the kit on a hidden noindex route so the page board can show arrangements instead of listing their names.

sections.heading: Raised in a family home
sections.intent: The opener says who we are and what the visitor is looking at. It carries the promise the rest of the page has to keep.
sections.why: The first screen decides whether the rest of the page is read, so the opener is judged as its own arrangement.

sections.heading: At A Glance
sections.intent: The three figures a reader wants before they read anything else. Each one is resolved from a data file, never typed.
sections.why: A counter strip is the fixture's only way to prove the per-page figure rows render and resolve.

refresh.note: ring tiles rather than the homepage's flush line, so a guide reads as a reference page

sections.heading: How our puppies are raised
sections.intent: The prose section: what happens between birth and collection. It is the shape most sections of a real page will use.
sections.why: Most sections of a rebuilt page are prose with one image, so the fixture has to exercise that branch.

tree.heading: The first eight weeks
tree.intent: Puppies stay with their mother for the first eight weeks.

tree.heading: Health checks
tree.intent: Every puppy has a full veterinary health check before it leaves.

images.prompt: a blue Staffordshire Bull Terrier in a family home

sections.heading: What our owners say
sections.intent: One review slot, so the board shows the single and grid arrangements side by side.
sections.why: A review slot reads very differently as one quote given room and as a grid, and that is a pick, not a default.

sections.heading: Questions we are asked
sections.intent: The FAQ rows, so the accordion arrangement is judged with real questions in it.
sections.why: The FAQ is the longest block on most pages and its arrangement changes how much of the page it eats.
